//: Copy this file to llm_devices.json in the same folder (it is gitignored). Only 'devices' is read; 'examples' is ignored, so a plain copy just gives you the local Ollama with nothing to misconfigure. To add a machine, move one entry from 'examples' into 'devices' and fill it in. 'This computer' is always offered and never needs an entry; an entry with "mode": "local" and a "model" sets its default chat model. See the README for what each field means.

examples.label: Remote Ollama (SSH tunnel)
examples.note: Preferred for a remote machine: the address and key come from your ~/.ssh/config entry, so nothing is stored here and the remote Ollama can stay bound to localhost.

examples.label: Remote Ollama (direct HTTP)
examples.note: Needs the remote Ollama bound beyond localhost (OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0) and the port reachable.

examples.label: Hosted gateway
examples.note: Any OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. api_key_env names the environment variable holding the key, never the key itself. extra_body carries anything non-standard the gateway needs; this one stops vLLM models reasoning before they answer.

examples.label: Hosted endpoint with short-lived tokens
examples.note: For an endpoint whose key is a short-lived token, such as a Run:ai inference endpoint on SPIKE. Set token_url and the two env-var names in place of api_key_env. The app trades the client id and secret for a token (client-credentials grant) and renews it before it expires.
